note: Monona County (IA) publishes its zoning map only through a Sidwell Portico viewer (site MononaIA). Its Geocortex site and ArcGIS REST endpoints return HTTP 500 ('failed to initialize', 'Could not create SSL/TLS secure channel'), and the zoning MapServer URL is not readable from the site. No other official county or Onawa zoning service was found: Onawa's ArcGIS webmap holds only a basemap. The only zoning polygons found are Iowa State's non-official compilation (services.arcgis.com/XORNS2fPFySPlBgy, zoning_districts_all_data_v2), which has 10 Onawa districts, 6 of 7 sampled polygons valid (fails 90% check), and no unincorporated coverage. Not a public queryable county zoning service.
